profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: As CTO and Co-Founder of clubcloud, LLC, I lead the technical development of an early-stage SaaS platform tailored to the operational needs of fitness and racquet club executives. My contributions include architecting and building the platform from the ground up, integrating Stripe for payments, and designing cloud infrastructure with Odoo.sh and AWS. I also implement engineering practices like Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines to enhance team productivity and reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Maintained API (NestJS/NodeJS/TypeScript) and web frontend (React/TypeScript) of Guardian, a flagship product for organizing corporate and law enforcement investigations.
* Improved and managed the deployment cycle for Guardian via the use of AI workflows, saving dozens of DevOps cycles per week.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Deployment Management · NestJS

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Co-founded clubcloud, an early-stage SaaS startup, and served as the primary technical decision-maker.  
• Architected and built the platform from the ground up with a small team, ensuring robust functionality.  
• Developed integrations with third-party APIs, including USTA, Stripe, and USIO, enhancing user experience.  
• Established engineering practices such as Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines, promoting efficiency and reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) · AWS Lambda · TypeScript · Claude · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Object-Relational Mapping (ORM)

positions.title: PhD Computer Science
positions.description:
● Leading research into multi-language/polyglot programming by leveraging dependently typed functional
programming tools such as Lean 4, publishing novel work in top conferences such as Principles of
Programming Languages (POPL).
● Taught computer science fundamentals in game development courses for high schoolers.
● Led a human-computer interaction (HCI) research project on Mastodon privacy policy usage by applying
statistical modeling methods with Python and Pandas.

positions.title: Game Programming Instructor (Bridge to Calculus)
positions.description: Teaching high school students Computer Science through game programming using Construct3

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

• Developed user-friendly front-end solutions for both commercial clients and the Department of Defense.  
• Contributed to a comprehensive survey of machine learning algorithms for authorship attribution, enhancing the understanding of the field.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Bash · Python · AI/ML · Software Infrastructure · TypeScript · React.js · Angular

positions.description:
* Supporting main instructor in teaching concepts for full-stack development
* Guiding students as they learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, NodeJS, MongoDB, and SQL
* Hosting office hours for students to ask questions on a one-on-one basis

projects.title: Cubies
projects.description:
Cubies is web-based tool for people interested in edge unfolding polycubes that I developed under advisement from Dr. Andrew Winslow from the University of Texas Rio Grande Valley.

It's very front-ended, using 99% JavaScript and the THREE.JS library to handle graphical computations.

Currently, I’m updating the code to reflect a higher standard, emphasizing readability and performance.

publications.title: Epstemic Logic for Polyglots
publications.publisher: Partial Evaluation and Program Manipulation · Nov 28, 2025
